description: NOTE: This event is at 1PM Central/2PM Eastern. Join Team AMG for a postcard writing meetup to help spread the word about Amanda Marie Green’s campaign for Congress! Spend time with fellow supporters and help us reach North Florida voters with a personal message ahead of Election Day.
